youtube_title: Hull-House, 1913: the week Chicago lined up to see a 'devil baby'
body: In 1913, crowds lined up in Chicago to see a devil baby. The rumor said a baby with hooves and a tail was hidden at Hull-House, Jane Addams's settlement house on Halsted Street. For six weeks, people streamed in from all over the city, asking to see it. Addams said there was no such baby. "No amount of denial convinced them that he was not there," she wrote. Each immigrant group told its own version of the story. There never was a devil baby. But legend says Hull-House is haunted anyway. Today it's the Jane Addams Hull-House Museum, open to the public. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Chicago #HullHouse #Legend #Haunted #History #LaPorteAfterDark

Sources: Jane Addams, "The Devil Baby at Hull-House," The Atlantic (Oct. 1916), via the Jane Addams Papers Project; Jane Addams Hull-House Museum (UIC); WTTW, Chicago Mysteries; Chicago Examiner (Oct. 31, 1913), via UIC.
